status: Local guided redesign completed and verified against main a3d2cad; owner review and publication remain separate.

completion.outcomeNote: Sample values only. New predictionResult describes whether the specific prediction happened, separately from the historical predictionComparison difficulty field. Neither field is derived from the other. Actual enums/booleans come exclusively from user state; completion means the app flow finished, not that a real event succeeded.
completion.exit: onAttemptEvent action=exited then onExit; no forced reflection
completion.privacy: No situation, prediction, plan, practice words, observation, learning or next-step wording in host outcome or history.state. Confirmed try wordings remain only in private local records/explicit export.

hostRegistration.existingIntegration: Tara is already registered in ResetFlow, catalogue, /tara-tactician route, saved return, validated export and deletion. No new registration or registry count change is needed.
hostRegistration.componentImport: Existing lazy import of TaraTacticianExperience and existing ResetFlow callbacks remain compatible.
hostRegistration.coarseOutcome: Existing enum/boolean allowlist remains unchanged. Never spread the local draft into host history or infer difficulty from prediction result.
hostRegistration.sharedContracts: This patch changes only Tara-owned files. Dear 2100 gate, host router, shared sound handoff, shared JourneyOptions and secondary alternatives from a3d2cad remain unchanged.
hostRegistration.journeyPlacement: Tara renders the existing JourneyOptions after main content and save status, as a secondary footer action.
hostRegistration.typecheck: Full-project typecheck passed with current host import.

storage.contents: One resumable draft and at most 20 explicitly saved recaps
storage.writeContract: Read-back verified; failed/unavailable storage leaves editable in-memory state and a truthful error
storage.resume: Refresh restores authored words, selected context, practice progress and phase. Back changes the viewed question without rewinding selected private content or confirmed practice.
storage.delete: Clear Tara data deletes draft and all recaps; existing app-wide deletion covers mentation. and clears mounted Tara state via its event
storage.integrity: Unreadable/future-schema data is preserved until the user chooses deletion
storage.completedRecap: A persisted completionReported flag prevents a normal recap refresh from emitting another completion; saved-recap browsing is review-only. Host session persistence is authoritative if local writes fail.
storage.exportIntegration: Existing exportLocalAppData uses loadTara validation and includes current Tara records in explicit device data export.
storage.savedMemoryIntegration: Current flagshipMemory SHARED_RETURN_KEYS includes the Tara key and emits mentation:tara-cleared after verified deletion; app-wide deletion is also observed.
storage.experienceVersion: Additive experienceVersion=3 in unchanged schemaVersion=1 container. Includes prepareView, bounded two-beat practice responses/current wording/explicit tried flags/confirmed wording snapshots, optional usability and explicit carryChoice. Versions 1 and 2 load without changing original outcomes or inventing confirmed tries; unsupported versions remain protected.

visualReference.chosenTreatment: Selected Calm Steps reference adapted into an ivory/aqua character entry, contextual coaching, deliberate tactics, two imagined practice beats, a pocket plan and dark-teal live support. Existing Tara artwork is preserved.
visualReference.asset: public/media/brand/tara-tactician.webp already exists in base repository; no image edit or new dependency
visualReference.checkpoint: guided-redesign/baseline/: 14 baseline rendered states; guided-redesign/after/: 15 final states at 390px and 320px/24px root text, full and viewport PNGs with hashes.
visualReference.review: Actual pixels inspected locally. Previous practice-first approval is historical and does not constitute approval of this new redesign. Qualitative review and limitations are in guided-redesign/review.md.
visualReference.finalProductionCaptures: guided-redesign/verification/main/: 10 actual compiled host screenshots from main a3d2cad plus this local Tara patch, with production-results.json.

validation.browser: 30 isolated authored-flow/lifecycle scenarios passed; no page errors. Includes 320px/24px and 390px, all five prediction results, legacy v1/v2 phases, genuine try vs choice, save/resume, Back, keyboard/focus, storage failure/retry and verified deletion.
validation.productionBrowser: 2 actual compiled /tara-tactician -> /reset mobile flows passed on latest main plus this patch. No page errors, HTTP/request failures or external requests. Browser-aborted local home document/art/ambient loads caused by leaving Home are recorded separately.
validation.build: npm run build passed; existing large-chunk warning remains
validation.nativeLimit: No iOS simulator/device run in this Linux executor. No usability study, clinical effectiveness test or numeric improvement claim.

release: Local branch codex/tara-guided-redesign-20261007-main based on a3d2cad. No redesign push, merge, source upload or deployment performed.
